statement: A successful non-system user-partition REPLACE target outcome wakes the canonical remote source owner through the existing replica-dispatch ingress, with bounded retry ownership and no wake for local, terminal, incompatible, or expired operations; deterministic real-seam tests prove the owner handoff and red-on-revert behavior.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The durable operation source node remains the canonical coordinator owner for a non-system REPLACE. A remote target outcome may wake it only through the existing REPLICA_OPERATION_DISPATCH ingress; no parallel transport, direct repository mutation, or target-side ownership is introduced.

Remote wake eligibility is limited to a coordinator-created non-system REPLACE whose durable row is still SYNCING and whose executor outcome reports replica-create ACTIVE. Other operation types, steps, outcomes, terminal rows, local ownership, or incompatible shapes do not wake a remote owner.

Initial dispatch and target-outcome wake remain distinct modes but share the existing retry registry, step deadline, operation timeout, stop, and cleanup lifecycle. Expiry or terminal observation stops retries; no unbounded timer or second retry owner is added.

Target-outcome retry diagnostics name the resolved source-owner destination, while initial-dispatch diagnostics retain the operation target. Logs must not present a target node as the remote outcome handoff destination.

A real-seam red-on-revert test proves the remote source owner is woken and retry accounting follows it, then attacks local, terminal, wrong-step, wrong-outcome, wrong-operation-type, timeout, retry-stop, and diagnostics boundaries. Adjacent coordinator handoff and executor-outcome routing suites stay green.

This Quest closes only the deterministic remote-outcome delivery building block. It does not claim the parent formation demo or MovieLens live proof is solved; the combined production-composed run remains required by the parent/cutover Quests.
scripts/run-user-partition-remote-executor-outcome-owner-wakeup-scenarios.js emits the sealed scenario and fails closed on empty, skipped, todo, missing, or failing TAP evidence.
